region_zh: 瑞士 · 恩加丁与瓦莱州
title_zh: 两座山谷之间·瑞士阿尔卑斯慢行
title_en: Between Two Valleys: A Slow Journey Across the Swiss Alps
subtitle_zh: 圣莫里茨三晚、冰川快车全景穿越、采尔马特三晚，把阿尔卑斯留给清晨与黄昏
subtitle_en: Three nights in St. Moritz, the full Glacier Express crossing, and three nights in Zermatt — keeping the Alps for dawn and dusk
lodge_zh: 圣莫里茨山居酒店、采尔马特山景酒店（按季节与偏好甄选）
lodge_en: Curated mountain hotels in St. Moritz and Zermatt, selected by season and preference
route_zh: 苏黎世 → 圣莫里茨（3晚）→ 冰川快车 → 采尔马特（3晚）→ 苏黎世或日内瓦
route_en: Zurich → St. Moritz (3 nights) → Glacier Express → Zermatt (3 nights) → Zurich or Geneva
intro_zh: 这不是一条追着瑞士地标奔跑的环线，而是在两座山谷各住三晚。先在恩加丁高原适应山地节奏：湖边散步、缆车上山，把午后留给长餐与水疗；随后用一整天乘冰川快车穿越阿尔卑斯腹地，抵达无车小镇采尔马特。接下来的日子不以“登顶”为唯一目标，而是围绕天气与体力，在马特洪峰观景、轻徒步、村落生活和酒店时光之间留出余白。全程可按季节选择更偏户外、滑雪、美食或纯度假的版本。
intro_en: This is not a circuit that races from landmark to landmark. It gives each of two Alpine valleys three unhurried nights. Begin on the Engadin plateau, easing into mountain time with lakeside walks, a cable-car ascent, long lunches and spa afternoons. Then devote a full day to crossing the Alps aboard the Glacier Express before arriving in car-free Zermatt. The days that follow are not built around summits alone: weather and energy shape a gentle balance of Matterhorn viewpoints, easy walks, village life and time at the hotel. Each journey can lean toward hiking, skiing, gastronomy or pure retreat according to season.

items.title_zh: 抵达苏黎世，前往圣莫里茨
items.title_en: Arrive in Zurich and continue to St. Moritz
items.desc_zh: 机场迎接后，以一等座铁路或专车进入恩加丁山谷。入住圣莫里茨甄选酒店，傍晚只安排湖边短走与休息，让身体慢慢适应海拔。
items.desc_en: Meet your host at Zurich Airport and continue into the Engadin by first-class rail or private car. Check in to a curated St. Moritz hotel, with only a short lakeside walk planned for the evening as you settle into the altitude.

items.title_zh: 圣莫里茨与恩加丁湖区
items.title_en: St. Moritz and the Engadin lakes
items.desc_zh: 跟随当地向导认识圣莫里茨的度假传统，再沿湖区选择一段轻松步道。午后不赶行程，可回酒店水疗、在露台用餐，或按季节安排帆船与雪地活动。
items.desc_en: Discover St. Moritz's resort heritage with a local guide, then choose an easy trail through the Engadin lake district. Keep the afternoon open for the spa, a long terrace lunch, sailing or a snow experience depending on season.

items.title_en: An unhurried day in the Engadin
items.desc_zh: 根据天气在山间观景台、静谧村落与谷地步道中择一深游。今日刻意只设一个主题，让风景、午餐与山谷日光自然决定节奏。
items.desc_en: Let the weather choose one focus: a mountain viewpoint, a quiet Engadin village or a valley walk. The day deliberately holds a single theme, allowing the landscape, lunch and changing Alpine light to set the pace.

items.title_zh: 冰川快车全景穿越：圣莫里茨至采尔马特
items.title_en: The full Glacier Express crossing to Zermatt
items.desc_zh: 乘冰川快车完成约八小时的阿尔卑斯全景穿越，经过峡谷、山口与高架桥。可按预算和余位选择一等座或 Excellence Class；车票、强制订座及餐饮配置以出发日期为准。抵达后步行或电瓶车前往酒店。
items.desc_en: Cross the Alps on the approximately eight-hour Glacier Express journey through gorges, mountain passes and viaducts. Choose First Class or, subject to budget and availability, Excellence Class; tickets, mandatory reservations and dining arrangements are confirmed for the actual travel date. Continue to the hotel on foot or by electric vehicle on arrival.

items.title_en: A first encounter with the Matterhorn
items.desc_zh: 在天气最清晰的时段前往马特洪峰观景区域，路线与高度由顾问根据季节、雪况和体力选择。午后回到无车小镇，留时间给老村漫步与酒店休息。
items.desc_en: Use the clearest part of the day for a Matterhorn viewpoint, with route and altitude selected around season, snow conditions and your energy. Return to the car-free village for an old-town walk and an unhurried hotel afternoon.

items.title_en: A day in the mountains above Zermatt
items.desc_zh: 夏季可安排向导轻徒步或高山野餐，冬季可改为滑雪体验或雪地漫步。强度从亲子友好到进阶路线均可调整，并为天气变化保留替代方案。
items.desc_en: In summer, choose a guided easy hike or Alpine picnic; in winter, switch to skiing or a snow walk. Difficulty ranges from family-friendly to advanced, with a weather-safe alternative held in reserve.

items.desc_zh: 不预设必去清单。可以重返最喜欢的山景、预约水疗与长午餐，也可以请顾问临时安排摄影、直升机观景或私家体验；所有项目均视天气、许可与实际资源确认。
items.desc_en: No fixed checklist today. Revisit a favourite view, book a spa and long lunch, or ask the advisor to arrange photography, a scenic helicopter flight or another private experience, always subject to weather, permissions and live availability.

items.desc_zh: 早餐后前往苏黎世或日内瓦机场。顾问会根据国际航班时间倒排铁路或专车衔接，并为冬季天气预留安全冗余。
items.desc_en: After breakfast, continue to Zurich or Geneva Airport. Your advisor will build the rail or private-transfer connection backward from the international flight time, with extra contingency for winter conditions.
